task.ques: Search for a queen-sized, hypoallergenic mattress topper on Amazon. It should have a memory foam material and be priced between $50 to $100.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: WQSPRING 4 Inch Mattress Topper, Queen — $65.00 on Amazon (item price before shipping/import charges).

The selected size is Queen (60 × 80 inches). The product title specifies memory foam, and the About this item section explicitly describes hypoallergenic construction with shredded memory foam inside. This meets the queen-size, hypoallergenic, memory-foam, and $50–$100 item-price requirements.

Source: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0H1LS7JN6
Checked October 27, 2026. Evidence: final.png shows the product name, hypoallergenic description, selected Queen size, and $65.00 price together.
